description: Computed financial views from Finbook data. Requires account name and view key.

parameters.account: Account name (required). Call without account to list available accounts.
parameters.fy: Financial year like '2025-26', or omit for all years. Not all views use this parameter.

views.title: Income Summary
views.description: Income breakdown by category with totals for taxable income, relief under Chapter VI-A, and TDS.

views.title: Capital Gains
views.description: Buy-sell matched transactions with gain/loss, holding period classification (LTCG/STCG), and aggregate totals.

views.title: Stock Transactions
views.description: All stock buy and sell entries with matching, transfer type, and FY/quarter classification.

views.title: Stock Holdings
views.description: Current holdings with quantity, average cost, and total portfolio value as of a specified date.

views.title: Stock Purchases
views.description: Raw stock purchase and transfer-in records.

views.title: Stock Sales
views.description: Raw stock sale and transfer-out records.
